Definition: to urge severely, i.e. (figuratively) importune, embolden, capture, act insolently
BiblicalUsage: 1) to behave proudly, act stormily or boisterously or arrogantly; 1a) (Qal) to act insolently, storm against, beset, importune; 1b) (Hiphil) to disturb, alarm, awe, confuse, make bold or proud
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
